title: A reading on an open work order shows 'In the shop' until invoiced
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset exists that has a mileage and engine-hours history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab; a work order carrying the same asset is also available.
custom_steps:
1. On an open (not yet invoiced) work order carrying the asset, enter a reading and save.
  2. Look at how that value is labelled on the asset and in the history.
  3. Invoice the work order and look again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A reading entered on an open work order shows as 'In the shop' rather than recorded, until that work order is invoiced.
  • The invoice is what fixes it into the recorded history; until then the shop can see the value but the history does not yet carry it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10567 (S10, Enter a reading); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S10; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R11: “A reading entered on an open work order shows as In the shop rather than recorded, until that work order is invoiced. The invoice is what fixes it, per S10-R10, so between the two there is a value the shop can see and the history does not yet carry”
